# Test Data Guide: [CS-54] User Story PP-005

**Generated:** 2026-08-24
**Generated By:** testcase-agent/skills/generate-testcases
**User Story:** CS-54 — User Story PP-005
**Module:** PP — Production Planning & Control
**Feature:** MRP Run and Planned Order Generation

---

## Purpose

This guide explains how to populate the test data JSON file (`CS-54-testdata.json`) with real SAP system values for execution. Each `{{PLACEHOLDER}}` in the JSON must be replaced with a valid value from your SAP S/4HANA Cloud test system.

---

## General Instructions

1. Open `testdata/CS-54/CS-54-testdata.json` in a text editor
2. For each placeholder `{{PLACEHOLDER_NAME}}`, replace it with the actual value from your SAP test system
3. Use the SAP system tenant: **my426318.s4hana.cloud.sap** (as per project configuration)
4. All values must come from a **test plant/test system instance** — do NOT use production data
5. Verify that all master data (materials, plant, MRP controller, work center) exists in SAP before test execution
6. Date placeholders should use relative dates (e.g., today + 7 days for future dates)

---

## Placeholder Definitions and Sourcing Instructions

### General Master Data

| Placeholder | Description | Where to Find in SAP | Example Value |
|-------------|-------------|---------------------|---------------|
| `{{MATERIAL_NUMBER_FINISHED_PRODUCT}}` | Finished product material number configured for MRP planning | Material Master (MM03) → Material Type FERT → MRP 1 view → MRP Type not ND | `FG-001` |
| `{{MATERIAL_DESC_FINISHED_PRODUCT}}` | Material description | Material Master → Basic Data 1 → Material Description | `Finished Product 001` |
| `{{PLANT_CODE}}` | Production plant code | Plant Master (OX10) → Plant Code | `1710` |
| `{{MRP_CONTROLLER_CODE}}` | MRP controller code | Material Master → MRP 1 view → MRP Controller field | `001` |
| `{{PLANNING_MODE_NET_CHANGE}}` | Planning mode (1=Net change, 2=Regenerative, 3=Reorder point) | MRP Run screen → Planning Mode dropdown | `1` |
| `{{PROCESSING_KEY_NETCH}}` | Processing key (NETCH, NEUPL, or combined) | MRP Run screen → Processing Key field | `NETCH` |
| `{{MINIMUM_LOT_SIZE}}` | Minimum lot size from material master | Material Master → MRP 1 view → Minimum Lot Size field | `10` |
| `{{WORK_CENTER_CODE}}` | Work center code | Work Center Master (CR03) → Work Center Code | `WC-1710-01` |

### Date and Time Placeholders

| Placeholder | Description | How to Calculate | Example Value |
|-------------|-------------|------------------|---------------|
| `{{PLANNING_HORIZON_FROM_DATE}}` | Planning horizon start date | Use current date or today's date | `2026-08-24` |
| `{{PLANNING_HORIZON_TO_DATE}}` | Planning horizon end date | Use current date + 30 days (typical planning horizon) | `2026-09-23` |
| `{{PLANNING_HORIZON_FROM_TODAY}}` | Planning horizon start date (for EDGE-04) | Use current date | `2026-08-24` |
| `{{PLANNING_HORIZON_TO_1_DAY_FROM_TODAY}}` | Planning horizon end date (for EDGE-04) | Use current date + 1 day | `2026-08-25` |
| `{{PLANNED_START_DATE}}` | Planned start date (auto-calculated by MRP) | MRP calculates based on lead time; use any future date for reference | `2026-09-01` |
| `{{EXPIRY_DATE_RAW_MATERIAL}}` | Expiry date of raw material batch | Use current date + 5 days (near expiry for shelf-life test) | `2026-08-29` |

### Stock and Requirements Placeholders

| Placeholder | Description | Where to Find in SAP | Example Value |
|-------------|-------------|---------------------|---------------|
| `{{CURRENT_STOCK_LEVEL}}` | Current stock level for finished product | Material Master → Stock/Requirements List (MD04) → Available Stock | `50` |
| `{{CURRENT_STOCK_LEVEL_MM}}` | Current stock level from MM module | Transaction MMBE → Stock Overview → Unrestricted Stock | `50` |
| `{{NET_REQUIREMENTS_CALCULATED}}` | Net requirements (demand - stock) | Stock/Requirements List → Net Requirements row | `100` |
| `{{PLANNED_ORDER_QUANTITY}}` | Planned order quantity (auto-calculated by MRP) | Stock/Requirements List → Planned Order row → Quantity | `100` |
| `{{NET_REQUIREMENTS_1_DAY_PERIOD}}` | Net requirements for 1-day planning horizon | Stock/Requirements List with 1-day horizon → Net Requirements | `20` |
| `{{NET_REQUIREMENTS_EQUAL_TO_MIN_LOT_SIZE}}` | Net requirements exactly equal to minimum lot size (EDGE-01) | Use the same value as `{{MINIMUM_LOT_SIZE}}` | `10` |
| `{{NET_REQUIREMENTS_BELOW_MIN_LOT_SIZE}}` | Net requirements below minimum lot size (NEG-04) | Use a value less than `{{MINIMUM_LOT_SIZE}}` (e.g., min lot size - 1) | `9` |
| `{{NET_REQUIREMENTS_EXCEEDS_LOT_SIZE_BY_ONE}}` | Net requirements exceeding fixed lot size by one unit (EDGE-02) | Use `{{FIXED_LOT_SIZE}}` + 1 | `101` |

### Capacity Placeholders

| Placeholder | Description | Where to Find in SAP | Example Value |
|-------------|-------------|---------------------|---------------|
| `{{CAPACITY_LOAD_PERCENTAGE}}` | Capacity load percentage | Capacity Overview (CM01) → Work Center → Capacity Utilization % | `75%` |
| `{{AVAILABLE_CAPACITY_UNITS}}` | Available capacity in units (hours or pieces) | Capacity Overview → Work Center → Available Capacity | `100 hours` |
| `{{CAPACITY_UTILIZATION_PERCENTAGE}}` | Capacity utilization percentage | Capacity Overview → Work Center → Capacity Utilization % | `80%` |
| `{{TOTAL_CAPACITY_UNITS}}` | Total capacity of work center | Work Center Master → Capacity tab → Total Capacity | `200 hours` |
| `{{LOADED_CAPACITY_EQUALS_TOTAL}}` | Loaded capacity (100% utilization for EDGE-03) | Use the same value as `{{TOTAL_CAPACITY_UNITS}}` | `200 hours` |
| `{{AVAILABLE_CAPACITY_ZERO}}` | Available capacity (zero for EDGE-03) | Use `0` for boundary test | `0` |
| `{{CAPACITY_UTILIZATION_100_PERCENT}}` | Capacity utilization at 100% | Use `100%` for boundary test | `100%` |

### Lot-Sizing and Rounding Placeholders

| Placeholder | Description | Where to Find in SAP | Example Value |
|-------------|-------------|---------------------|---------------|
| `{{FIXED_LOT_SIZE}}` | Fixed lot size from material master | Material Master → MRP 1 view → Fixed Lot Size field | `100` |
| `{{ROUNDING_INCREMENT}}` | Rounding increment or lot multiple | Material Master → MRP 1 view → Rounding Value field | `10` |
| `{{PLANNED_ORDER_QUANTITY_ROUNDED_TO_MIN}}` | Planned order quantity rounded to minimum lot size | Use `{{MINIMUM_LOT_SIZE}}` value | `10` |
| `{{PLANNED_ORDER_QUANTITY_ROUNDED_TO_NEXT_LOT}}` | Planned order quantity rounded to next lot | Use `{{FIXED_LOT_SIZE}}` * 2 (if requirements exceed by one) | `200` |
| `{{PLANNED_ORDER_QUANTITY_EQUAL_TO_MIN}}` | Planned order quantity equal to minimum lot size | Use `{{MINIMUM_LOT_SIZE}}` value | `10` |

### Negative Scenario Placeholders (NEG-01, NEG-02, NEG-03, NEG-04)

| Placeholder | Description | Where to Find in SAP | Example Value |
|-------------|-------------|---------------------|---------------|
| `{{MATERIAL_NUMBER_NOT_MRP_CONFIGURED}}` | Material with MRP Type = ND (not planned) | Material Master → MRP 1 view → MRP Type = ND | `MAT-NO-MRP-001` |
| `{{MATERIAL_DESC_NOT_MRP}}` | Material description for non-MRP material | Material Master → Material Description | `Material Not Configured for MRP` |
| `{{RAW_MATERIAL_ID_SHORTAGE}}` | Raw material component with shortage | Material Master → BOM → Component Material Number | `RM-SHORTAGE-001` |
| `{{RAW_MATERIAL_DESC_SHORTAGE}}` | Raw material description | Material Master → Material Description | `Raw Material Shortage 001` |
| `{{CURRENT_STOCK_RAW_MATERIAL_INSUFFICIENT}}` | Current stock of raw material (insufficient) | Stock/Requirements List → Available Stock (use value < required) | `5` |
| `{{REQUIRED_QUANTITY_RAW_MATERIAL}}` | Required quantity of raw material | BOM → Component Quantity * Planned Order Quantity | `50` |
| `{{SHORTAGE_QUANTITY_CALCULATED}}` | Shortage quantity (required - available) | Calculate: `{{REQUIRED_QUANTITY_RAW_MATERIAL}}` - `{{CURRENT_STOCK_RAW_MATERIAL_INSUFFICIENT}}` | `45` |
| `{{RAW_MATERIAL_ID_SHELF_LIFE}}` | Raw material with shelf-life configuration | Material Master → Material with Shelf Life Expiration Date | `RM-SHELF-LIFE-001` |
| `{{RAW_MATERIAL_DESC_SHELF_LIFE}}` | Raw material description | Material Master → Material Description | `Raw Material Shelf Life 001` |
| `{{REMAINING_SHELF_LIFE_DAYS}}` | Remaining shelf life in days | Batch Master → Remaining Shelf Life (use value < minimum) | `3` |
| `{{MINIMUM_SHELF_LIFE_DAYS}}` | Minimum shelf life requirement in days | Material Master → Minimum Remaining Shelf Life field | `7` |

## Pre-Execution Checklist

Before running the test cases, verify the following in your SAP test system:

- [ ] All materials listed in the test data exist in the material master
- [ ] All materials are configured for MRP planning (MRP Type not ND), except `{{MATERIAL_NUMBER_NOT_MRP_CONFIGURED}}`
- [ ] Plant `{{PLANT_CODE}}` is active and configured for MRP processing
- [ ] MRP controller `{{MRP_CONTROLLER_CODE}}` is active and assigned to materials
- [ ] Work center `{{WORK_CENTER_CODE}}` is active with capacity data maintained
- [ ] BOM and routing/recipe data are configured for finished product materials
- [ ] Sales orders exist in SD module (for INT-01 test case)
- [ ] Current stock levels are set up in MM module (MARD table)
- [ ] Raw material with shelf-life configuration exists (for NEG-03 test case)
- [ ] Raw material with insufficient stock exists (for NEG-02 test case)
- [ ] Planned orders exist (for conversion test cases TC-CS-126, TC-CS-127)

## Notes

- **Auto-populated fields** (e.g., `materialDesc`, `currentStock`, `plannedOrderQuantity`) are system-generated or calculated by SAP. Include them in the JSON for verification purposes, but they are NOT entered by the user during test execution.
- **Date formats:** Use ISO 8601 format `YYYY-MM-DD` for all dates.
- **Relative dates:** Use relative date calculations (e.g., today + 7 days) to ensure test data remains valid over time.
- **Test data isolation:** Use dedicated test materials, plant, and MRP controller codes to avoid impacting production data.
